title: SDD apply — tui
content:
All **15 TUI acceptance scenarios** are implemented and green (`go test ./...`). Built on the existing starter (Bubble Tea + `internal/project` seam).

### Surface
- Dashboard: project name, `ENV:`, variables, status footer
- Secrets masked (`●●●●●●●●`); secret edit shows `********` prior placeholder
- Add / edit / delete (`y` confirm); compare across all envs; `v` validation in status area
- Providers, agent activity, approval modal (Allow once / Allow for project / Deny)

### Review (post-polish)

## Standards
- Removed dead `ViewValidate`; validations stay on the dashboard status line
- Documented `A` (pending approval) in README
- Remaining judgement: Bubble Tea in-place model updates (idiomatic); `project.go` still large

## Spec
- All 15 covered by `internal/tui/acceptance_test.go`
- Scenario 6: prior secret now masked via placeholder (not omitted)
- Scenario 11: seeds check + metadata audit rows
- Intentional: proposed new values shown cleartext in approval modal

**Commit:** `dd3b356` — `fix(tui): tighten secret-edit mask and agent activity coverage`
